2005.why: It drew about twice the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about doors, locks & latches.
2005.pln: about twice the average car's complaints
td: Doors & locks
Lock and unlock every door from the fob and the switch, and open each one.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Lights
Walk around with the lights on: headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals.

2006.why: It drew about twice the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about electrical.
2006.pln: about twice the average car's complaints
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.

2007.why: It drew about two-thirds as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about body structure. 2007 is one of the better years of a model that draws 1.3× the average car's complaints.
2007.pln: about two-thirds as many complaints as the average car
td: Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Doors & locks
Lock and unlock every door from the fob and the switch, and open each one.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.

2008.why: It drew somewhat fewer complaints than the average car in its first 3 years, most about body structure. 2008 is one of the better years of a model that draws 1.3× the average car's complaints.
2008.pln: somewhat fewer complaints than the average car
td: Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Doors & locks
Lock and unlock every door from the fob and the switch, and open each one.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
